home.quote: Give a tool manifest no script named like a verb.
A new tool manifest needs a toolchain pin that reaches it, such as `engines.node` or `requires-python`.

With the place chosen in Inputs 7: add each tool, at the same version, to the manifest, lock it with the tool's own command (`npm install --save-dev --save-exact`, `uv lock`, `go get -tool`), then change each command to read it.
Make sure `dependabot.yml` (or the Renovate config) has an entry for the manifest's ecosystem and directory ([`add-repo-hygiene`](add-repo-hygiene.md), HYG-09).
